description: This file defines the RemindersService class, which provides functionalities to list and add reminders using EventKit. It includes methods for fetching reminders with filtering and creating new reminders with specified properties.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A service class implementing RemindersServicing protocol, providing methods to list and add reminders.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reminders based on provided filtering parameters, returning up to a specified limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new reminder with given parameters such as title, notes, due date, and list assignment.
